tools.name: search_wikipedia
tools.description: Search current English Wikipedia by keywords or by meaning. Returns short, citable paragraphs with title, section, link, revision and license. Use it for facts about people, places, events, science and history.

tools.name: watch_page
tools.description: Ask WikiVectors to POST a signed JSON callback to your https URL each time an English Wikipedia page is edited, moved or deleted. Returns the watch id and a secret (shown once) for checking the X-WikiVectors-Signature header. At most 100 watches per key; costs no searches. If you can't receive callb

tools.name: changes_since
tools.description: List edits, moves and deletes of English Wikipedia pages that WikiVectors applied since a time, oldest first, with diff links. Narrow it to up to 50 page titles. Counts as one search.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "watch_page" references sensitive artifacts (secret). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: Ask WikiVectors to POST a signed JSON callback to your https URL each time an English Wikipedia page is edited, moved or deleted. Returns the watch id and a sec…

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: watch_page · Private data: watch_page · Public sink: watch_page.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: watch_page · Private data: watch_page · Public sink: watch_page

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
